body:
// CHK-001: Absent APB5 signals drive zero, mst domain (AB2-3-45, AB2-20.2-08, AB2-3-44, AB2-8-04, AB2-8-05, AB2-8-06, AB2-8-08)
  a_CHK_001: assert property (@(posedge i_clk_mst) disable iff (!i_rst_n_mst) 1'b1 |->
      (((PARA_APBCDC_APB5 != 0) && (PARA_APBCDC_USER_DATA_W != 0)) || (o_apb_pruser == '0)) &&
      (((PARA_APBCDC_APB5 != 0) && (PARA_APBCDC_USER_RESP_W != 0)) || (o_apb_pbuser == '0)))
    else begin fails_CHK_001++; $display("NNC_FAIL CHK-001 @%0t", $time); end
  always_ff @(posedge i_clk_mst) if (!(!i_rst_n_mst) && (1'b1)) hits_CHK_001 <= hits_CHK_001 + 1;

  // CHK-001: slv domain part: pwakeup, pauser, pwuser (AB2-3-45, AB2-20.2-08, AB2-3-44, AB2-8-04, AB2-8-05, AB2-8-06, AB2-8-08)
  a_CHK_001_slv: assert property (@(posedge i_clk_slv) disable iff (!i_rst_n_slv) 1'b1 |->
      ((PARA_APBCDC_APB5 != 0) || (o_apb_pwakeup == 1'b0)) &&
      (((PARA_APBCDC_APB5 != 0) && (PARA_APBCDC_USER_REQ_W != 0)) || (o_apb_pauser == '0)) &&
      (((PARA_APBCDC_APB5 != 0) && (PARA_APBCDC_USER_DATA_W != 0)) || (o_apb_pwuser == '0)))
    else begin fails_CHK_001++; $display("NNC_FAIL CHK-001 @%0t", $time); end
notes: The header declares `LPARA_STRB_W`, `LPARA_REQ_W` and `LPARA_RESP_W` with the default `Derived`, which is not defined anywhere. A localparam declared in the body is seen too late, which is the cause of the USEBEFOREDECL errors. The harness must supply `Derived`, for example by replacing it with an expression such as `PARA_APBCDC_DATA_W/8` or by defining it in $unit. This body is untested because the header does not elaborate as given. Only the mst-domain assertion has a hit counter, because only `hits_CHK_001` exists. A second always_ff on the slv clock would drive the same variable from two procedures.
